title: NHL linesman helped off ice after Sabres’ Jiri Kulich awkwardly falls onto his leg
content:
Linesman Ryan Daisy was helped off the ice after an apparent leg injury during the game between the Montreal Canadiens and Buffalo Sabres on Tuesday.

The injury happened just minutes into the game, when Sabres forward Jiri Kulich was shoved and fell onto Daisy’s left leg directly off a faceoff.

Daisy, 38, is in his 11th season in the NHL and has officiated more than 600 games. He was tended to by trainers and eventually helped off the ice by Canadiens’ Jake Evans and Owen Beck.

The NHL later announced that Daisy would not return. The game continued with a single linesman, Tommy Hughes.
